description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, hostname, and environment variables within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for external functions and metadata, as well as macros for module identification.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Class providing system information such as memory, CPU load, hostname, environment variables, and time settings within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Nested class representing a snapshot of system memory and swap statistics, with JSON serialization.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of physical pages.

methods.name: GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory and swap stats.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Serializes memory snapshot data to JSON format.
